cta.title: Ready to elevate your defence acquisition strategy?
cta.description: Connect directly with our Indian Air Force veteran advisory board to navigate DAP 2020 frameworks, indigenisation programs, and strategic partnerships.

faqs.q: Who leads the consultancy at Labradorite?
faqs.a: The advisory is led by Air Commodore Arvind Srivastava, an Indian Air Force veteran with 30+ years of military aeronautical engineering service, and former Deputy Director General Technical (Air) in Defence Capital Acquisition at the Ministry of Defence.

faqs.q: What areas of defence and aerospace do you specialise in?
faqs.a: Our core competencies include Defence Capital Acquisitions under DAP 2020 (IDDM, Make, D&D categories), Aircraft MRO setup & base modernization, regulatory airworthiness approvals (DGCA/DGAQA/CEMILAC), and aerospace supply chain indigenisation.

faqs.q: How does Labradorite support defence offsets and ToT?
faqs.a: We assist foreign OEMs and Indian entities in structuring offset programs, navigating offset banking, and orchestrating Transfer of Technology (ToT) absorption compliant with MoD guidelines.

faqs.q: Can startups and MSMEs engage with your advisory?
faqs.a: Yes. We guide aerospace startups and MSMEs through iDEX challenges, Make-II/Make-III schemes, MoD vendor registration, and technical pitch alignment against military Service Qualitative Requirements (SQRs).

faqs.q: What is the engagement model for advisory services?
faqs.a: We engage through structured feasibility assessments, long-term project-management retainers, and milestone-linked consultation agreements based on operational scope.

blogs.title: Navigating DAP 2020: Strategic Imperatives for Make in India Defence Contracts
blogs.author: AVM Tyagi (Retd.)
blogs.summary: A comprehensive guide to Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP) 2020, focusing on indigenous content calculation, trial methodologies, and capital category selection.
blogs.content:
The Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP) 2020 represents a decisive paradigm shift towards empowering the indigenous aerospace and defence manufacturing industry. Under the strategic vision of Aatmanirbhar Bharat, capital acquisitions now prioritize Buy (Indian - IDDM), Buy (Indian), and Make categories with stringent indigenous content requirements.

Key Strategic Takeaways for Vendors:
1. Indigenous Content Calculation: DAP 2020 enforces verification through statutory auditor certifications and detailed bills of materials.
2. Field Evaluation Trials: Trials now follow rigorous non-negotiable compliance parameters with no second chances for baseline failure.
3. Offset Banking & Multipliers: Capital contracts exceeding thresholds mandate high-technology transfers with attractive investment multipliers.

Working closely with veteran defence consultants ensures that RFI and RFP bids avoid common compliance pitfalls and accelerate through technical evaluation committees.

blogs.title: Establishing Resilient MRO Hubs Across Indian Defence Industrial Corridors
blogs.author: Arvind Sharma
blogs.summary: Examining the development of domestic Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul capabilities in Tamil Nadu and Uttar Pradesh Defence Industrial Corridors.
blogs.content:
India’s aerospace and defence fleet sustenance requires transitioning from overseas depot overhauls to self-sustaining domestic maintenance hubs. The two dedicated Defence Industrial Corridors (UP & Tamil Nadu) provide unprecedented tax incentives, land allocations, and specialized testing facilities.

Crucial Elements for Successful MRO Alliances:
- Transfer of Technology (TOT): Structuring phased transfer of depot-level diagnostics and line replaceable units (LRUs).
- Tri-Service Compatibility: Designing maintenance infrastructure that supports common airframe and avionics architectures.
- Private-Public Partnerships: Synergizing with HAL and base repair depots (BRDs) to scale operational availability.

Our consultancy actively bridges Tier-1 aerospace innovators with vetted local infrastructure providers to build enduring MRO capability.

blogs.title: iDEX & Innovations for Defence Excellence: The MSME Catalyst
blogs.author: Kane & Strategic Cell
blogs.summary: How startups and MSMEs are disrupting Indian defence technology through iDEX challenge grants and SPARK schemes.
blogs.content:
Innovations for Defence Excellence (iDEX) is transforming how the Indian Armed Forces source cutting-edge technologies—from AI-driven tactical surveillance to advanced composite materials. However, small businesses frequently struggle with military-grade testing protocols and compliance documentation.

Bridging the Prototype-to-Production Chasm:
1. Milestone Tracking: Structured project management prevents delay in grant disbursals.
2. User Trials Preparation: Simulating high-altitude, desert, and extreme environmental testing conditions before formal military trials.
3. Scaled Capital Procurement: Leveraging successful iDEX prototypes into long-term procurement contracts under DAP Make II provisions.

blogs.title: Operational Flexibility: High-Technology Asset Leasing Under DAP 2020
blogs.author: Labradorite Financial Advisory
blogs.summary: Analyzing the strategic advantages of equipment leasing over outright capital purchases for rapid operational deployment.
blogs.content:
Leasing introduced under DAP 2020 allows the Ministry of Defence and armed services to access critical mission assets without heavy upfront capital expenditure. From maritime reconnaissance platforms to flight simulators, leasing mitigates technological obsolescence risks and slashes acquisition lead times.

Financial & Operational Advantages:
- Budget Predictability: Fixed operational expenditure models rather than variable lifecycle maintenance burdens.
- Rapid Fleet Ingestion: Immediate deployment capability for urgent tactical training and surveillance missions.
- Lessor Guarantees: Structured performance benchmarks ensuring high platform availability rates round the clock.
